title: Account fees and minimum-balance charges
overview: Minimum-balance conditions and account fees depend on the chosen product. An average-balance rule is not necessarily the same as a daily minimum, and some variants may have different conditions; do not assume a fee waiver applies.
procedure: Call Sense Bank's fictional schedule supplies the demo balance condition and any listed charge. Ask a demo agent to review the configured product before explaining a posted synthetic fee; no unlisted amount may be invented or waived by the assistant.

title: Card annual and replacement charges
overview: Card fees can relate to issuance, annual service or replacement, and may differ by card product. A lost-card replacement may not follow the same conditions as a routine expiry renewal; taxes or conditions should not be assumed.
procedure: Use the structured fictional card-fee schedule for any numerical example. For a specific synthetic charge, verify the demo profile and ask an agent to compare the entry with that schedule; a real fee dispute needs issuer review.

title: Transfer, cheque, ATM and loan charges
overview: Service charges may depend on transaction type, channel and product terms. A transfer fee, an ATM operator surcharge and a loan late charge are distinct items and should not be conflated into one quoted amount.
procedure: The demo fee schedule is the only source of bank-specific amounts in this prototype. If a requested fee is not configured, the assistant explains the relevant category and directs the amount question to a reviewer rather than inventing a number.
